content:
The test failed because of a formatting mismatch in `/root/mailer_policy_summary.md`. The validator expected comma-separated thousands (e.g., '27,000.00'), but the script produced plain numbers (e.g., '$27000.00'). 

Error Trace:
E AssertionError: assert '27,000.00' in '# Mailer Policy Summary\nTotal 45-day margin (USD): $27000.00\nTotal 90-day margin (USD): $1641.60\nAbsolute difference (USD): $25358.40\nDecision: keep_45_day\n'

To fix this, update the Python script to format currency values in the Markdown summary using `f'{value:,.2f}'` instead of just `f'{value:.2f}'`.
